description: Preview and commit cruise delete operations atomically. First call cruise_get for expectedVersion. Omit confirmationToken to preview, show the changes to the user, then repeat the unchanged request with its token only after the user approves. Reuse idempotencyKey for retries. Omitting a field preserves it; null clears nullable fields. For commercial cruise reservations and sea/port days use cruise_* tools. Never substitute Activity, CruiseActivity or another segment type for a cruise day. Ordinary shore excursions remain valid Activity/CruiseActivity. If cruise tools are unavailable explain the limitation and ask for clarification.

confirmationToken.description: Omit to preview. After the user reviews and approves the exact preview, repeat the unchanged request with its token to commit. Never manufacture approval.

expectedVersion.description: Exact version returned by cruise_get, including the trip-only read before creating a cruise.
